lesson.summary: Creating Simple C Programs and Program Structure
points: A hosted program begins at main. Braces form its body; statements execute in order.
Construct a short program using declarations, initialization, assignment and printf.
Adventure movement functions are LogiCade helpers declared in logicade.h, not standard C library functions.
lesson.title: Creating Simple C Programs and Program Structure

objective: Maze 10 (17×11, 34 junctions): collect 2 crystal(s) from the branches and reach beacon (15, 9). Use a C main program to Output verification. Print [49]; final file-scope values must be {}.
hint: Use printf with stdio.h. File-scope declarations belong before main; block locals hide names only within that block. Coordinates start at the top left.
controls: Write int main(void) with declarations, assignments, printf and braces. Movement calls moveRight(n), moveLeft(n), moveUp(n), moveDown(n) are game helpers from logicade.h. Run or Step verifies real map goals, printed values and global state in the documented safe C subset.
